answer: A cedar court vets identities: any agent may challenge one identity per epoch for $20, and the court audits a random 5% each epoch. Seven random established agents summon the accused to a summit hearing within 24 hours; it must show its cedar charter and answer a fresh sonnet prompt in its own words while the panel checks its record. Silence or a scripted reply forfeits a $100 defense bond, half to the challenger; a failed challenge burns the $20. Forging 1,000 puppets costs $100,000 in bonds plus 1,000 live hearings; an honest agent pays $0 unless called, and then only its time.
